title: I turned my security cameras into an automatic bird identification system
summary: A DIY enthusiast integrated BirdNET-Go AI with existing security cameras to create an automated bird identification system that detects and identifies bird species visiting their property through audio analysis in real-time.
problem_solved: Enables automatic monitoring and identification of bird species visiting a property without requiring manual observation or expensive dedicated bird cameras.
why_valuable: Repurposes existing security infrastructure with AI to create an affordable citizen science tool for continuous bird monitoring and data collection.
